meta.parties: Poowatchy Umma Et Al. v. Cassim Maricar Et Al

rules.statement: A purchaser at a Fiscal's sale is not bound to inquire into the correctness of the order of execution or the judgment upon which it issued.
rules.supporting_quote: "See on this point the observations of the Privy Council in Rewa Mahton v. Ram Kishin Singh (1) ."
